title: 2020 in haiku
hook: Over the course of 2020, Eli Holder paid workers on Mechanical Turk to turn news headlines into 5/7/5-syllable poems. The result: 2,760 “Doom Haikus,” which you can browse on a timeline or download in bulk. For each poem, the dataset also includes the original article URL, date processed, headline, and SEO snippet.
